name: SMABench Pilot Seed Manifest
scope: Seed benchmark classes for secure messaging app implementation attack-surface assessment.

seed_classes.metric: Component counts, exported status, permissions, intent actions, schemes, hosts, MIME types.
Categorized occurrences for media handling, deep links, QR/device linking, storage, crypto/session, native/FFI, network/sync, WebView.
Informational Semgrep findings from ASEMA-specific generic rules.
Local test/build/lint status for supporting 577i prototype libraries.

non_goals: No live app or server probing.
No claim that informational static indicators are vulnerabilities.
